# Sketchfab CC BY 4.0 town assets (2026-11-10) — attribution required

Downloaded 2026-11-10 through the user's logged-in Sketchfab session in Chrome (`i/models/<uid>/download` -> archive entry ->
signed URL -> loopback-only receiver on 127.0.0.1:8765, CORS limited to sketchfab.com, never overwriting; receiver stopped and
tab closed afterwards). At download time each model page / API record was re-checked: licence "CC Attribution", downloadable,
no NoAI tag. "Asian Shop 4" carries a spam tag "ai" next to the author's note to ignore the tags (the model is made in
Blender, its texture references were generated with ChatGPT according to the description); this is not the Sketchfab NoAI
flag. No purchase, no account creation. Unmodified originals stay outside Assets in `ThirdParty_raw/sketchfab_assets_20261110/`
(not in the repository). Free availability is not a training-data approval: everything here is background scenery, never
labelled, and the simulator's research outputs stay `training_ready=false`.

## Content checks (2026-11-10)
- Every texture of the HK set was viewed (contact sheet, 123 images); brand signage found on 21 of them, all in the street block. The kept tower uses one facade texture and one roof material, no signage.
- The Asian Shop 4 texture: generic optician's shop front; telephone number removed. The Japanese house textures: generic tiles, siding, an air-conditioner unit, no text.
- The road-sign pack: official Korean traffic sign designs (public regulatory symbols), no brand marks.
- The soldier: a generic US-style uniform (camouflage, no unit insignia legible at 512 px). Used only as two stationary gate guards (user request); human-shaped infiltration assets (divers, infiltration team members) are not part of this batch.
